text: The quantized field mode has energy ladder E_n = hbar*omega(n + 1/2). What is the energy of the vacuum state |0>?
choices: It is undefined because |0> is not a physical state
explanation: Setting n = 0 gives E_0 = hbar*omega/2, the uncertainty-enforced zero-point energy. It is not zero (choice 0 drops the 1/2), not hbar*omega (that is n = 1), and |0> is a perfectly physical state, the vacuum (choice 3).
